subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Enterprise Financial Services
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@enterprisefin.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan — Enterprise Financial Services

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciated the team's time and questions. Re-cap / next steps below to make sure we're aligned on scope and success criteria for a short POC. I've attached a one-page POC scope and our internal checklist.

High-level recap of today's demo:
- Showed LLM-powered transaction classification + anomaly-signal enrichment use case.
- Walked through latency/cost tradeoffs, dedicated capacity options, and data residency controls.
- Discussed sample data ingestion approach (SFTP -> VPC connector) and evaluation metrics.

Proposed POC objectives (2-4 weeks):
1) Success criteria (what Enterprise Fin needs to validate):
   - Model accuracy: classification F1 >= 0.88 on labeled holdout set (primary)
   - Latency: p95 generation <= 200ms for single-request flow (production-like test)
   - Ops: automated prefix caching reduces token cost by >= 15% on standard workload (secondary)
2) Scope / eval plan:
   - Week 0 (kickoff): confirm dataset, ingestion method, and security checklist (owner: Enterprise Fin - Sarah + Tom)
   - Week 1: ingest 10k anonymized rows to Redwood test environment; Redwood provides sample pipeline and docs (owner: Redwood - Dylan)
   - Week 2: run batch eval and interactive test; collect metrics and qualitative feedback (owner: Enterprise Fin / Redwood joint)
   - Week 3: tuning, final report, and go/no-go decision (owner: Marissa / Sarah)
3) Deliverables from Redwood:
   - Test API keys & example ingestion pipeline
   - POC dashboard with accuracy/latency/cost breakdown
   - Final readout and recommended next steps for Dedicated vs Hosted deployment
4) Logistics / timelines:
   - Target start: next Monday, 2027-04-12 (flexible)
   - Estimated duration: 3 weeks (can extend to 4 if extra integration time required)

Questions / asks for Enterprise Fin:
- Can you confirm the dataset owner and whether the 10k rows can be provided anonymized by 2027-04-09?
- Any specific compliance evidence the procurement team needs during the POC (SOC2 attestation, IP addendum, etc.)?

Attachments: POC_Scope_EnterpriseFin.pdf (1-page scope), redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx

Next steps (my propose):
- You confirm dataset availability + procurement contacts by EOD Friday 2027-04-09
- I'll create a shared Drive folder and kick off the pre-kickoff checklist with Dylan to provision test keys

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15m sync if you want to walk through the timeline live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the thorough recap and the POC doc. That aligns closely with what we discussed. A couple of quick notes from our side:  

- The accuracy target looks good, but for executive buy-in we also need recall >= 0.85 on the fraud class (we can make this a secondary success metric).
- Timeline: procurement needs to review the data processing addendum - can procurement triage that in parallel? I'll loop in Tom (security lead) and Procurement.
- Dataset: we can provide an anonymized 10k sample by 2027-04-09, but we need a secure upload method (SFTP or pre-signed GCS link).

We'll review the attachments and I expect procurement to respond with the DPA questions by Wednesday.

Cheers,
Sarah
Director, Data & Analytics | Enterprise Financial Services
